precedence: TASK + ADDENDUM + RAW_BUDGET_AMENDMENT + ANALYSIS_LEAD. P0 version remains frozen; v2 governs main preparation subject to a later READY.

source_grouping.physical_scene_uniqueness: Per-task across main splits; quantified actual qpos/qvel/target/model positions and quaternion orientation before first action. Registry excludes seed/RNG/time.
source_grouping.replacement_policy: Only pre-action duplicate initial scene or reset initialization technical failure, two ordered pre-registered reserve seeds per primary slot; failed attempt retained; actual episode bootstrap identity and planned_slot_id both saved

training_cuts.fallback_eligibility: Only already observed nonterminal legal anchor with >=10 steps remaining; retain missing if none; no outcome/Q-based choice; training split only

approved_parameters.evaluation_cut: first legal G0 alarm; no-alarm/early-success episodes retain their shared native10 outcome

expected_logical_labels.note: Planned upper bounds; unreachable cuts and exact audited physical reuse reduce new attempts. Logical slots are not independent episodes.

approved_parameters.g0: initially frozen; separate analysis target/input review required before adapting G0

loss.average_order: within valid distinct candidates/pairs, then across source groups

ensemble.bagging: task-stratified episode bootstrap with replacement; save complete draws and multiplicities

A.initialization: read-only old four-member weights; fresh warm start for round1 and final fits

B.initialization: fresh initialization for all four members in round1 and final fits
B.projection: fit current-stage training split only; refit on combined rounds for final stage

training_stages.round2_generation: one round1 critic chosen on development, frozen before every round2 source; never updated within round2 collection

auxiliary_old_data.status: exposed historical data, not native10 or independent heldout

model_selection.dataset: same 100-episode development candidate bank for all A/B ensemble checkpoints
model_selection.candidate_selector: argmax mean member success probability; a0 wins ties
checkpoint_criteria_in_order: maximize full-planned-episode real paired net gain of selected candidates versus a0
model_selection.calibration: 100 episodes/20 distinct physical initial scenes per task, 2 repeats; selected model, low freedom pre-registered rule, no weight/PCA updates
model_selection.heldout: 100 episodes/20 distinct physical initial scenes per task, 4 repeats, only after final model/method/acceptance freeze

candidate_schema.schema_status: slot names and mask details proposed for post-P0 review; semantic families approved

normal_control.name: continue_native10
normal_control.target_use: replan-normal interruption benefit and separate policy evaluation; never pad old queue into critic slot0

candidate_schema.channel_radius_multiplier: 0.5 or 1, balanced by task/round from preregistered source identity
candidate_schema.channel_full_direction: isolate corresponding XYZ/gripper component of final post delta; half is exactly 0.5 of same feasible delta
candidate_schema.random_direction: critic-independent Gaussian three temporal knots per dimension with linear interpolation
candidate_schema.gradient_degeneracy: preregistered smooth random fallback for affected channel, retain diagnostic flag; never choose fallback by outcomes
candidate_schema.matching: actual velocity/direct/post retain registered deployment construction; channel and random +/- pairs use their specified symmetric feasible deltas; never feed all 13 into one common minimum-radius matcher
candidate_schema.raw_action_representation: execute raw_a0+delta; critic sees C=clip(raw_a0+delta,-1,1); P0 must verify the approved representation/physics invariants

training_runtime.purpose: canonical singleton preprocessing; real fitted PCA/reload/FrozenObjective probabilities and gradients require real-data audit before fit/export claims

implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.deterministic_randomness: derive and persist separate initialization, task-bootstrap and minibatch seeds from the frozen workflow namespace plus phase/path/member; do not select seeds from outcomes
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.B_PCA_fit_sample: approved: unique valid current-stage train rows, before bootstrap; all four B members share train-only projection
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.complete_label_requirement: four valid paired repeats per logical candidate after audited alias expansion; missing attempts are unknown, never failure=0
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.deduplication_identity: same source state/cut, exact raw executed ten-step commands, same suffix stream/protocol and frozen VLA; never deduplicate from clipped commands alone
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.candidate_loss_weight: one per valid distinct command group; slot aliases each carry inverse multiplicity if expanded
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.gain_mask: one per valid distinct group different from a0; candidates aliasing a0 excluded from gain denominator
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.pair_mask: both candidate groups valid and distinct; collapse duplicate unordered group pairs once; identical +/- or zero delta pair contributes no pair weight
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.invalid_symmetry: nonzero pair symmetry violation is an audit error, not a silently masked training sample
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.empty_gain_or_pair_term: zero for that source; retain source in outer average and retain its valid a0 BCE
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.source_average: uniform over sampled complete source groups; bootstrap multiplicity is intentional, no outcome-dependent weighting
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.cross_radius_use: save half/full curve and paired differences as diagnostics; no unapproved fourth loss or radius-normalized gradient target
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.non_a0_candidate_tie: lowest registered slot after a0 priority
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.tie_tolerance: exact deterministic comparison unless a numerical tolerance is explicitly preregistered before outcomes
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.failure_coverage: retain failed/unreachable/no-alarm planned episode records; technical missing outcomes block complete-selection claims rather than being imputed as failure
implementation_proposals_requiring_revie.fallback_cut_order_status: approved by ANALYSIS_LEAD section3; main implementation pending tests
